note: GGK-1000 new series P-58,59 (Kamenskoe), "Karta chetvertichnykh obrazovaniy", VSEGEI 1983 (explanatory note Aleksandrov et al. 1985; print year not legible on the preview), geokniga record 42713; RASTER = 2000x1456 px PREVIEW (~0.35 km/px), downloaded 2026-09-30, internal_only ("for familiarisation only"). NO LEGEND ON THE PREVIEW: indices read from the map labels where legible (5-9x zoom, blurred), genetic letter cross-checked against the colour families of P-58_g3 and Q2500; seeds = flat-pixel k-means centres (K=50) of the face, several per unit. Frame: 4 corners read at 12x on the inner edge of the minute bar + 20 ties on the top/left edges + 12 interior 1-deg x 40-min graticule crossings, --proj eqdc 47/62 lon_0 168 (page top/bottom 0.8863 = eqdc 47/62 0.8863; sheet cone 0.8769), affine rms 303 m (max 0.68 km), spline through all points; independent interior check before the graticule ties: median |offset| 0.8 px on meridians, 0.1 px on parallels; the tool colour envelope sat on the beige minute bar along the Bering-Sea side (BR corner 7 px out), so it is not used. Zones (--restrict): WATER only in the open-sea polygon (Penzhina Bay, Korf and Olyutorsky bays, Bering Sea); mIII/mIV only within ~8.6 km of it. gIII dE<=9, fIII dE<=7, both must survive a 1-px opening (brown/olive valley line mixtures); weak seeds dropped after validation: gIII #a8776b #a18462 (C 48-63 %), fIII #8f8665 (GF 11-16 %). Not read: lithology/symbol overprints, lakes (white, filled from neighbours), labels inside one tint (cIV pink also carries gIV/gIII cirque-moraine labels). Extraction: work/pv_ne/jpg_to_polygons_pv.py (copy of scripts/jpg_to_polygons.py whose --thin-units thins every fill of a unit), options in work/pv_ne/extract_opts_p.txt; pale floodplains; the pale fIII4 outwash shares this tint (Q2500: 34 % fIII on P-59)
